intended_object: This is one direction of a component of the counit isomorphism in the proof that presheaves on `CostructuredArrow yoneda A` are equivalent to `Over A`. It lives in the `OverPresheafAux` namespace, and its docstring reads "Backward direction of the counit."
explanation: This is an auxiliary function, used only inside a proof. It sits in the `OverPresheafAux` namespace, and Mathlib uses it to build the counit of the equivalence between presheaves on `CostructuredArrow yoneda A` and the category `Over A`. It sends an element of `OverArrows (yonedaCollectionPresheafToA F) s.hom` to `F.obj (op s)` by transporting a component along an `eqToHom` map. It is one half of a bijection used inside that construction, not a mathematical notion in its own right.
